subject.title: Castro Valley Unified School District Board, Area 3

text: My education and qualifications are: I bring a parent’s perspective, diverse representation, and accountable leadership to the Board. I am the daughter of a community college science professor, Five Canyons homeowner since 2007, California public school and UCSD graduate, and parent of two CVUSD students. I speak English, Cantonese, and Mandarin. My deep commitment to our schools is proven by my extensive volunteer work. I have served our schools as Independent Elementary PTA Treasurer, School Site Council member, CV Booklegger, FAME Coordinator, and have supported the CV Education Foundation, CVHS FIRST Robotics Team, CVHS Athletic Boosters, and secured community sponsorships for programs like the CVHS Marching Band. I will focus on measurable progress in literacy, math, student well-being, and college and career readiness, while supporting rigorous academics, expanded learning opportunities, and a safe school culture. Every student—from TK, SpEd, to adult school—deserves rigorous academics, a safe school culture, and support to succeed. I will prioritize resources that benefit students, evaluate programs based on results, and support sustainable strategies to attract and retain excellent educators. I am committed to listening, collaborating, and making thoughtful, student-centered decisions for every family in our district. I ask for your support and vote on November 3. karawong4cv.com

text: My education and qualifications are: Every child deserves the opportunity to succeed. That belief is why I am running for the Castro Valley Unified School District Board of Education. As a proud product of public education, a parent, a Financial Leader, and a proud Trustee Area 3 resident for more than twenty years, I understand that strong schools are built through responsible leadership, fiscal stewardship, collaboration, and trust. My husband and I chose Castro Valley because of its outstanding schools and strong sense of community. Today, our son is a proud graduate of Castro Valley Unified, and our daughter continues her education in the district. As your Trustee, I will listen to students, families, educators, staff, and our community. I will work to improve student achievement, strengthen reading and math proficiency, support safe and inclusive schools, and ensure taxpayer dollars are invested wisely, transparently, and responsibly. Every decision I make will begin with one simple question: Will this improve outcomes for students? Together, we can build on Castro Valley’s tradition of excellence and create even greater opportunities for every student. Because every child deserves the opportunity to succeed. I would appreciate your support on this journey. Together we can make the possible happen.

text: My education and qualifications are: I am proud to submit my candidacy for Castro Valley Unified School District, School Board Trustee. I am a father of three students in the district, I served on the Executive Board for Castro Valley Elementary’s Parent and Teacher Association and I am a member, and former president of the Citizens Advisory Committee for the Hayward Area Recreation and Park District. In my work as president, I advised the Board of Directors on district operations and the development of recreation programs. For almost two decades, I have served as a Peace Officer and Public Information Officer in unincorporated Alameda County. As a Public Information Officer, I developed long standing relationships with community groups, key stakeholders, families, students, and educators. These relationships have been and always will be rooted in trust, transparency, and effective communication. If elected I will strive to ensure our schools are safe and equitable for everyone. I will work hard to improve our students’ quality of learning and access to advanced placement classes, and I will support teachers and collaborate with our local safety partners. A vote for me is a vote for safe campuses, educational excellence, and accountability.

text: My education and qualifications are: Our public schools are going through some tough times right now. With several Board members leaving, we have a great chance to bring in strong new leaders, fresh ideas, and a big focus on students and families. I have worked for 35 years as a licensed California Certified Public Accountant. Now I want to help in an even more important way—making sure our schools stay strong, exciting, and always focused on helping kids succeed. School money comes mostly from how many students attend. When fewer kids come, the schools get less money. Castro Valley schools have stayed strong because families choose us—including many families who live outside our district. We must keep earning that trust! As a Board member, I will be honest, speak the truth, and really listen to parents. I will help make sure our schools are kind places with no bias or unfair treatment. We will work hard to help all students do better without making standards easier. This election is very important for our schools’ future. If you want caring, professional leaders who get results, please vote for me. Together, we can build strong schools and a bright future for our kids!
